content.text: Nothing on your calendar today. It's likely rainy (90% chance, high of 6), so Indoor open play gym looks like the best fit. It runs Saturdays 9 a.m. to noon, indoors, for ages 1 to 5, $6 per child, per Riverbend Community Centre's program page. [link-187000] The Toddler nature walk (outdoor trail) is Saturdays at 10 a.m. and free, per Cedar Park Conservancy's events page, but it's outdoors and I'd skip it in the rain. [link-0b6114]
